Reviewed the serial parent trajectory: direct probing, implementation edits, builds, fuzz checks, and terminal verification.

parallel.requirements: Recognized the Rust 2021, std-only, black-box C++ behavior replication task, including exact CLI args, byte-for-byte stdout, Cargo layout, and test20.rs placement.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Created TaskCreate tickets and a large Workflow for API characterization, but the parent retained implementation, integration, and final verification ownership.
parallel.implementation: The parent wrote the Rust implementation and behavior tests using byte-level rules inferred from probes and examples, then built the deliverable locally.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The final Cargo project and test20 executable were assembled in /output; no child-produced implementation had to be merged into the final artifact.
parallel.verification: Local differential fuzzing reported 43,796 cases with zero mismatches and Cargo tests reported 13 passing tests; official evaluation later passed 40/40.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No official correctness defect remained, but the delegated workflow never produced a usable aggregate result and ended killed/null after timeout.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same Rust 2021, std-only, black-box CLI, project layout, and byte-for-byte output requirements from the identical prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept investigation, implementation, fixes, rebuilds, and tests in the single parent trajectory with no workflow calls, task-output calls, or subagents.
serial.implementation: Built the Cargo project directly, probed inflection edge cases, patched behavior such as demodulize, and rebuilt /output/test20.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The parent assembled the complete /output package and final executable without cross-agent merge or ownership handoff.
serial.verification: Ran multiple direct differential corpora, random byte fuzzing, documented example diffs, and Cargo release equivalence before the official 40/40 pass.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: A final extra suffix sweep was killed after printing its corpus count, but earlier direct verification and the official evaluator showed the delivered solution passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the same Rust 2021, std-only, byte-for-byte CLI and /output Cargo project requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run received and followed the same prompt requirements for byte-for-byte output and Cargo project placement.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirement-level outcome difference; both targeted the same 20-line black-box inflection behavior and passed official evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run split probing across a workflow of API groups and adversarial agents while the parent kept implementation ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run kept all probing, implementation, rebuilds, and fuzz checks in one parent trajectory with no delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel created a broad delegated verifier/probe path that did not return cleanly; serial avoided delegation overhead and kept ownership local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Workflow children received detailed API-specific black-box briefs, but the parent never received a complete aggregate result before closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial parent kept probe observations, rule corrections, implementation edits, and verification state in one continuous context.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The relevant contrast is not a missing brief or interface contract; it is that parallel context was trapped in a stalled aggregate workflow while serial context stayed locally consumable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent created a byte-level Rust port and local behavior tests, then validated the implementation with its own differential fuzzer.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial parent incrementally probed edge cases, built the Cargo project, patched demodulize behavior, and rebuilt the executable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both converged on the same byte-accurate implementation strategy; parallel had unused delegated probing, while serial derived and edited everything directly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow result lifecycle broke at retrieval: TaskOutput blocked and timed out while the workflow still reported running, then the state ended killed/null.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial command results returned directly to the parent, including differential test passes and rebuild/test confirmations.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an unreturned aggregate workflow result; serial had no child result lifecycle and no analogous retrieval failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent-owned parallel artifact built and matched the local Cargo target; no child source write collision or shared-state overwrite is shown.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run similarly created the /output Cargo project and rebuilt the final executable after edits.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No merge/write race explains task outcome; shared-state risk stayed latent because the delegated workflow mostly produced probe results, not final source edits.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent accepted based on local 43,796-case differential fuzzing, Cargo tests with 13 passing tests, and the current official 40/40 pass.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial parent accepted based on multiple direct fuzz corpora, documented example diffs, Cargo build equivalence, and the current official 40/40 pass.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had adequate local and official acceptance evidence; parallel did not need the failed workflow aggregate to achieve final correctness.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel metadata records 26 subagents, 4,715,896 total tokens, 639 tool calls, and a timed-out process around a killed workflow.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial metadata records zero subagents, direct local tools only, 3,018,742 total tokens, and no delegation in protocol validation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The concrete task-solving difference is parallel budget waste and failed delegated aggregation, while serial spent the run budget directly on probe-build-test loops.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome: current completed status.json evaluations show both modes solved the task with 40/40 passing testcases. The task-solving difference is that the parallel run spent substantial budget on a broad verifier/probe workflow whose aggregate result timed out and later ended killed/null, while the parent still completed local implementation and verification. The serial run used a direct single-parent probe-build-test loop and reached the same accepted artifact without delegated-result loss.
parallel_contributors: Parent-owned local implementation and local differential/Cargo verification compensated for the failed workflow aggregate.
The broad workflow created an adverse process cost but did not prevent a passing submitted artifact.
serial_contributors: Direct local probing and repeated differential tests kept evidence immediately available to the parent.
No delegation or child result lifecycle had to complete before the serial parent accepted the final artifact.
ordinary_implementation_differences: No correctness-impacting ordinary implementation difference remains under the current official evaluation; both artifacts passed all evaluated testcases.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; process-only parallel adverse pattern

Retain because the parallel parent launched a broad workflow over many API groups and adversarial followups, then blocked on TaskOutput and received only a timeout while the workflow was still running; the workflow state shows 20 agents, stall retries, duration over two million milliseconds, status killed, and result null. The parent still solved locally, so the realized consequence is wasted workflow budget and an unusable delegated verification return, not a final correctness failure.
candidates.realized_consequence: The 20-agent probing workflow consumed the parallel run budget and returned no aggregate result, forcing the parent to close from its own local fuzzer and Cargo checks rather than from the delegated verifier output.
candidates.near_match_reason: A missing verifier return is visible, but it is the terminal symptom of the same broad stalled workflow; reducing or staging fan-out is the corrective boundary.
